description: This file contains Pydantic schema definitions for a simulation engine, including data models for scenario analysis, factor graphs, entity profiles, decisions, and simulation insights.

classes.name: ScenarioAnalysis
classes.description: Schema for scenario decomposition, including entity type, decision type, options, analysis, and key attributes.

classes.name: FactorGraph
classes.description: Schema for the causal attribute graph, including attributes, attribute relationships, and sampling strategy.

classes.name: EntityProfile
classes.description: Schema for a single entity's attributes and a human-readable profile summary.

classes.name: EntityBatch
classes.description: Schema for generating multiple entities at once.

classes.name: EntityDecision
classes.description: Schema for an entity's decision, including confidence, key factors, trade-offs, and reasoning.

classes.name: SimulationInsights
classes.description: Schema for final simulation results, including outcome distribution, key insights, detailed analysis, segment patterns, and causal drivers.

classes.name: SimulationResult
classes.description: Schema for the complete simulation result, aggregating scenario, context, population size, analysis, graph, entities, decisions, and insights.
